caption: The drawing depicts a fragment of textile, shaped as an irregular polygon, positioned against a plain, off-white background. The textile features a vibrant, intricate pattern composed of floral and paisley-like motifs. The dominant background color is a rich, deep blue. Overlaying this blue are detailed, symmetrical designs in red, orange, and yellow shades, accented by green and light blue elements, and further detailed with small white and pink highlights. The pattern is densely packed, especially toward the left and central areas, where the paisley and floral shapes interlock closely. The right edge of the textile is incomplete and fades out, with sections at the lower right revealing an underlying pencil sketch of the same pattern, not yet filled in with color, displaying gray pencil lines on the cream background. The textile fragment appears frayed along its edges, especially at the top and left side, implying wear or unfinished status. The drawing focuses on the textile sample without including any other objects or background elements.
title: Printed Cotton
